lone_slime.name: Lone Slime
lone_slime.desc: A single slime. Your party outclasses it, so touching it on the map is an instant win.

slime_pack.name: Slime Pack
slime_pack.desc: Three slimes slam down their lanes. Learn to read and dodge lane attacks.

archer_nest.name: Archer Nest
archer_nest.desc: Archers shoot down their lanes, hitting the first thing in the way. Pull or shove a friend into their line of fire.

ember_court.name: Ember Court
ember_court.desc: Fire-immune wisps behind a lava moat. Fire is useless against them; push the Warden into the lava.

gauntlet.name: The Gauntlet
gauntlet.desc: Everything at once. You won't survive by trading blows.
